headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: The football legend leaves behind a legacy of 20 years in the sky blue and white jersey, sparking emotional tributes from teammates and fans worldwide.
details: Lionel Messi has officially announced his retirement from the Argentina national team, bringing an end to a 20-year international career that redefined the sport.
The superstar left a heartfelt three-page farewell message, reflecting on the journey, the struggles, and the ultimate joy of winning the World Cup.
Teammates like Angel Di Maria expressed deep emotion, stating it is hard to imagine the team without Messi in the iconic sky blue and white jersey.
FIFA President Gianni Infantino hailed Messi's career as extraordinary, noting that his magical talent and humility will be remembered forever.
Fans across the globe, including in Bangladesh, have expressed their grief and admiration for the 'eternal' captain who inspired millions.
Messi's farewell note emphasized his gratitude toward his family, coaches, and teammates who supported him throughout his professional journey.
caption:
20 years, one legendary jersey, and a final goodbye. Lionel Messi retires from the Argentina national team.

Lionel Messi has officially announced his retirement from the Argentina national team, bringing an end to a 20-year international career that redefined the sport.

The superstar left a heartfelt three-page farewell message, reflecting on the journey, the struggles, and the ultimate joy of winning the World Cup.

Teammates like Angel Di Maria expressed deep emotion, stating it is hard to imagine the team without Messi in the iconic sky blue and white jersey.

FIFA President Gianni Infantino hailed Messi's career as extraordinary, noting that his magical talent and humility will be remembered forever.

Fans across the globe, including in Bangladesh, have expressed their grief and admiration for the 'eternal' captain who inspired millions.

Messi's farewell note emphasized his gratitude toward his family, coaches, and teammates who supported him throughout his professional journey.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: BNP marks [[48th founding anniversary]] with tree planting and tributes
headline: BNP marks 48th founding anniversary with tree planting and tributes
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman led the celebrations, paying homage to the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.
details: Prime Minister and BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman marked the party's 48th founding anniversary today by planting a tree at Zia Udyan and releasing fish into Crescent Lake in Dhaka.
The celebrations began with Tarique Rahman paying homage to the graves of BNP founder Ziaur Rahman and former chairperson Khaleda Zia by placing wreaths around 9:20 am.
The party has announced a five-day central programme, which includes tree plantation, fish release, and a discussion session.
Earlier in the morning, national and party flags were hoisted at the BNP central office in Nayapaltan and the chairman's office in Gulshan.
Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi inaugurated a free medical camp organized by the Doctors Association of Bangladesh (DAB) at the Nayapaltan office.
Founded on September 1, 1978, by Ziaur Rahman with a 19-point programme, the BNP aims to build a self-reliant Bangladesh.
This anniversary is particularly significant as the party has returned to state power under Tarique Rahman's leadership.
It is also the first founding anniversary observed without Khaleda Zia, who passed away on December 30, 2025.
caption:
BNP celebrates its 48th founding anniversary today. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman leads the tributes and environmental activities.

Prime Minister and BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman marked the party's 48th founding anniversary today by planting a tree at Zia Udyan and releasing fish into Crescent Lake in Dhaka.

The celebrations began with Tarique Rahman paying homage to the graves of BNP founder Ziaur Rahman and former chairperson Khaleda Zia by placing wreaths around 9:20 am.

The party has announced a five-day central programme, which includes tree plantation, fish release, and a discussion session.

Earlier in the morning, national and party flags were hoisted at the BNP central office in Nayapaltan and the chairman's office in Gulshan.

Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi inaugurated a free medical camp organized by the Doctors Association of Bangladesh (DAB) at the Nayapaltan office.

Founded on September 1, 1978, by Ziaur Rahman with a 19-point programme, the BNP aims to build a self-reliant Bangladesh.

This anniversary is particularly significant as the party has returned to state power under Tarique Rahman's leadership.

It is also the first founding anniversary observed without Khaleda Zia, who passed away on December 30, 2025.

Source: The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV
